name: TransMedics (TMDX)
teaser: At $72.22 the shares trade 4.9% above my Base value of $68.82, a downside of 4.7%. That looks close to fair value, but the range is wide (Bear $25.87, Bull $108.70) and my two methods disagree by 30%: an exit multiple on 2028 EBITDA gives $81.74, a ten-year cash flow model gives $60.20. Owner cash after share-based pay yields 1.7% at today's price. Confidence is C and the required margin of safety is 45%, which puts the maximum buy price at $37.85. Hold for holders, watchlist for new money. Third quarter results are not in this analysis.
llms: Medical technology company selling organ care systems for transplants, valued on a discounted exit multiple on 2028 EBITDA cross-checked with a ten-year owner cash flow model; owner cash yields 1.7 percent and liver is 79 percent of revenue.
